name: joinforme
description: Send a bot into your Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams call to take notes, go instead of you, or sit in with you, and get the transcript back in your chat.

interface.shortDescription: Send a bot to your meetings
interface.longDescription: joinfor.me sends a bot into your Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams call. It can take notes, go instead of you and give your update, or sit in with you and answer from a brief. While the meeting runs you can check what is happening, have the bot say something, answer a question it passed on, or post in the chat. Afterwards you get the full transcript and can write the summary and follow-ups. The bot never agrees to deadlines, money or decisions for you, leaves when asked, and only you can send it. Free during the beta.
defaultPrompt: Take notes in my 3 pm call: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Go to standup for me and say the API is done
What was decided in my last meeting?
